name: wholeloop
description: A CLI-agnostic AI development harness that closes the whole loop: define, build, roll out, learn.
author: Iván González Sáiz <hi@dreamingecho.es>

scripts.docs:nav: npm run build && node dist/wl.mjs docs nav
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run smoke && node scripts/check-package.mjs && npm run commits:check && npm run docs:check && node scripts/generate-commands.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-config.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-providers.mjs --check && npm run harness:check && npm run lint:md && npm run lint:mermaid
scripts.docs:references: npm run build && node dist/wl.mjs docs reference --write
scripts.docs:providers: npm run build && node dist/wl.mjs docs reference --kind providers --write
scripts.docs:platforms: npm run build && node dist/wl.mjs docs reference --kind platforms --write
scripts.eval:definitions: npm run build && node dist/wl.mjs eval definitions test/evals/definition/corpus.json
scripts.eval:gates: npm run build && node dist/wl.mjs eval gates test/evals/gates/corpus.json --predictions test/evals/gates/baseline-predictions.json
scripts.eval:grounding: npm run build && node dist/wl.mjs eval grounding test/evals/grounding/corpus.json
